age_table.note: Exactly the same six count pairs. The conference age total is 2,635 and differs from 2,606 in the main series. Conference shorthand does not resolve the differing risk-set definitions.

retest_reconciliation.note: Figure 4c partitions the Figure 4b totals. Eleven people with severe symptoms after the first test were excluded from retesting. Its 12 symptomatic second tests after earlier mild or moderate symptoms are stored as a distinct source subset from the 13 both-symptomatic paired count in the later monograph.

observations.locator: Results, printed p. 282 (PDF p. 293)
observations.note: The surrounding text reports 2,606 people. The 45 reclassified administrative failures are printed as 1.65 percent, which does not reproduce 45/2,606. The exact failure denominator and reason for the mismatch are unavailable. This is a different endpoint from forced descent.
observations.protocol: RAF selection at 28,000 ft for up to two hours. Planned retest after 2–30 days. Actual oxygen delivery, eligibility for specific analyses and complete pressure histories are unavailable.
observations.outcome_window: During the physical test and source follow-up as described. Uniform delayed surveillance unavailable.
